explanation: At GO it is always near the top (10 when choosing a2, 8-9 when choosing a1); at D1 it is about 0-1 if the previous choice was a1, but if the previous choice was a2 it is 7-9 when that trial went unrewarded and 2-5 when it was rewarded (lower, 0-2, on the first trial or two after switching to a2 from a1). At D2, reaching S1 after choosing a2 (rare) gives 8-9, reaching S2 after a2 (common) gives 2-4 (0-2 right after switching to a2), reaching S1 after a1 (common) gives 1-7 and climbs over a long run of a1 trials, and reaching S2 after a1 (rare) gives 0-1.
